implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure does not automatically trigger Regulation 38 open offer duty—triggering depends on final acquisition percentage; a lawyer must verify whether disclosed stake crosses 15%, 55%, or other thresholds activating mandatory offer, creeping acquisition exemption, or other Takeover Code gates.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure requirement when acquirer reaches or crosses 5% of voting shares; no open offer obligation at 5% threshold unless combined with other factors.
Mandatory open offer required on acquisition of 15% or more shares; 5–15% acquisitions may trigger based on intent and aggregate effect.

framework.ref: SEBI (SAST) Regulations 2011, Regulation 4 (exemptions and creeping acquisition)
framework.note: Exemptions available under Rule 4 for exempted persons (PSU, sovereign wealth funds, etc.) and creeping acquisition up to 5% annually without open offer.
